tools.name: get_venture_chart_of_the_day
tools.description: Returns the most recent charts from Mode VC's Chart of the Day archive (one new chart per day, mostly AI model, adoption, developer-package and pricing data), newest first, each with its claim, takeaway, URL and cited sources.

tools.name: search_charts
tools.description: Searches every chart in the Mode VC Chart of the Day archive by keyword over title, claim, takeaway and keywords. Returns claims, takeaways, canonical URLs, markdown endpoints and cited sources. The archive grows by one chart a day; the response states its current size.

tools.name: get_chart_data
tools.description: Returns one chart from the Chart of the Day archive: the data table behind it (rows as published), claim, takeaway, note and the sources it cites. Look up by slug or title. Data is as published on the chart page; follow source_urls for the original data.

tools.name: calc_llm_inference_cost
tools.description: Estimates monthly LLM spend, cost per user and per request, prompt-cache savings, savings from routing a share of requests to a cheaper model, and gross margin against a target, for an AI product on any current Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek or Grok model at list price. Compares 9 common models. Same

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "llm-economics" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_venture_chart_of_the_day, search_charts · Private data: calc_llm_inference_cost · Public sink: calc_llm_inference_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_venture_chart_of_the_day, search_charts · Private data: calc_llm_inference_cost · Public sink: calc_llm_inference_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calc_llm_inference_cost" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Estimates monthly LLM spend, cost per user and per request, prompt-cache savings and gross margin for a usage profile on one of 8 models, compares all 8 models, and prices an 80/20 hybrid of DeepSeek and Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Same math and the same fixed price table as https://modevc.com/tools/llm-infe" → after: "Estimates monthly LLM spend, cost per user and per request, prompt-cache savings, savings from routing a share of requests to a cheaper model, and gross margin against a target, for an AI product on any current Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek or Grok model at list price. Compares 9 common models. Same"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
